title: Structure preserving quaternion conjugate gradient-type methods for solving non-Hermitian quaternion linear systems
summary: In this paper, we consider the non-Hermitian quaternion linear systems arising from color image restoration and three-dimensional signal filtering problems. For exploring to solve such systems, we present two innovative structure-preserving conjugate gradient-type methods, QNHERLQ and QNHERQR, which are based on the unitary equivalence transformations of the non-Hermitian quaternion matrices to tridiagonal forms, called quaternion Saunders-Simon-Yip tridiagonalization procedure.
